summary: The urge to break free gets much louder when the structure around you keeps demanding that you work around a problem nobody is willing to fix.
body: The urge to break free gets much louder when the structure around you keeps demanding that you work around a problem nobody is willing to fix. When Saturn squares Uranus, restriction and disruption grind against each other until the old way becomes increasingly difficult to maintain and the new way still carries consequences nobody wants to absorb. Frustration can make blowing everything up look cleaner than it actually is, especially when you are exhausted from adapting to something that should have changed already. Something needs to move. Make sure you are dismantling the restriction that caused the problem, not everything you built around it to survive.
